Where to Stay in Prachinburi?
12 Hotels We Actually Reviewed

heroSub: 12 hand-picked Prachinburi hotels across every budget — a garden resort on a lake, boutique resorts in the Khao Yai foothills of Noen Hom, a cacao farm stay at Prachantakham, a rafting base on the river at Na Di, and town hotels near Abhaibhubejhr. Covering the town centre, Noen Hom, Prachantakham, Na Di and Kabin Buri. From roughly ฿390–4,500/night.
introH2: 🌿 Why does choosing the right area in Prachinburi matter so much?
introHtml: Prachinburi — Thailand's herbal-medicine town — sits just 90 minutes from Bangkok, but its sights are spread across several areas that each feel very different. Stays fall into four sides — the town centre has the night market, a public park and sits near Chao Phraya Abhaibhubejhr Hospital, ideal if you're here on business, visiting a patient, or don't have a car; Noen Hom is the southern foothills of Khao Yai, with garden resorts and a mountain feel that's quieter than Pak Chong; Na Di is the white-water side at Kaeng Hin Phoeng with riverside nature; and Kabin Buri sits on Route 304, handy for an overnight stop on the way to Isan. Many people book without checking the area and end up driving back and forth all day. This guide rounds up 11 hand-picked Prachinburi hotels across every tier — all with real guest reviews, prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Prachinburi has no metro and its sights are spread out — so having your own car is by far the most convenient, as most foothill and riverside resorts sit outside town. Pick by your itinerary: the town centre (Na Mueang–Rop Mueang) lets you walk to the night market and public park and sits near Abhaibhubejhr, best if you don't have a car; Noen Hom is the southern Khao Yai foothills with garden resorts, near Khao Ito Waterfall and the road up to Khao Yai; Na Di is the Kaeng Hin Phoeng rafting side, with the strongest, most scenic water from July to October; and Kabin Buri sits on Highway 304, an easy mid-route stopover. Almost every stay has free parking, so they suit self-drivers well.

entries.name: Tawa Ravadee Resort
entries.badge: 🏆 Best garden resort in the province
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Si Maha Phot · Tha Tum · ~20 min to Abhaibhubejhr
entries.addr: 77 Moo 7, Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Tawa Ravadee is the best garden resort in Prachinburi for a self-drive getaway — 8.7 from 94 reviews, a WorldHotels Distinctive member. The grounds are a tropical garden with a lotus pond and lake, and all 199 rooms are 38 sqm with a private balcony looking onto the garden or water. Reviewers consistently praise the big outdoor pool, facilities beyond what town hotels offer, and a solid breakfast buffet. It had a major 2024 renovation and sits about 1.5 hours from Bangkok.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a lake-side room from the 2024 renovation — better views and a fresher feel. Request it with reception ahead of time.
pros: Garden-resort feel with a lotus pond and lake, very quiet
Spacious 38 sqm rooms with garden/lake-view balconies
Big pool, gym, sauna and tennis — rare in this province
Good breakfast, ~20 min from Abhaibhubejhr Hospital
cons: You need a car — nothing within walking distance
Wi-Fi is slow in some rooms and parts of the building are ageing

entries.name: Siamdasada Khaoyai
entries.badge: 🌳 A quieter Khao Yai, Prachinburi side
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Noen Hom · Khao Yai foothills · wide grounds with a lake
entries.addr: 179 Moo 12, Prachin–Khao Yai Rd, Noen Hom, Mueang Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Siamdasada Khaoyai is a boutique resort in the southern Khao Yai foothills that gives you the Khao Yai feel without the Pak Chong crowds — 8.6 from 78 reviews. The grounds are wide with a lake at the centre, 96 rooms in low two-storey blocks, two pools and bikes to ride around the lake. Reviewers praise the cleanliness, fresh-looking rooms and a feel that suits families and couples. It's a little over two hours' drive from Bangkok.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Families should pick a Pool Access room so kids can step straight into the water. The on-site restaurant closes early, so check times or bring something for dinner.
pros: Wide grounds with a lake — walk or cycle all day
Two pools, great for families with kids
Clean, fresh rooms with a quiet Khao Yai atmosphere
An easy ~2-hour self-drive from Bangkok
cons: Limited dining on site and the kitchen closes fairly early
Some inner-zone rooms ventilate poorly and smell musty in the rainy season

entries.name: myrrh. Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Noen Hom · between Khao Ito and Khao Yai
entries.storyHtml: myrrh. Resort is a new boutique resort with the highest review score in this guide — 9.2 (from 28 reviews). It's a cluster of about five private houses tucked into the Noen Hom valley between Khao Ito and the road up to Khao Yai. The draw is brand-new, spotless rooms, an on-site Myrrh. Cafe (open Fri–Sun), and the fact that it's pet-friendly — rare around Khao Yai. The breakfast is well reviewed and the feel is warm, like staying at a friend's place. From ฿1,500.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Larger groups should take the two-bedroom house. If you want the cafe, stay over a weekend, and book early — there are only a handful of houses.
pros: Highest score in this guide at 9.2, brand-new clean rooms
On-site Myrrh. Cafe to relax and take photos
Pet-friendly — bring your dog or cat
Quiet mountain setting and a generous breakfast
cons: Small property with few houses — fills fast on weekends
No pool, and the cafe only opens Fri–Sun

entries.name: Saengcha Farm Resort
entries.badge: 🍫 Cacao farm stay · make your own chocolate
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Prachantakham · Pho Ngam · waterfall side of Khao Yai
tags: 🌿 Near the waterfall side of Khao Yai
entries.storyHtml: Saengcha Farm Resort is the best stay in Prachinburi for travellers who want an experience more than just a room — 9.2 from 9 reviews. It's a small family-run working farm in Pho Ngam, Prachantakham, on the waterfall side of Khao Yai. The standout, and what international guests rave about, is that the farm grows its own cacao and has a chocolate workshop where you roast, grind and make chocolate by hand — plus owners who look after guests personally, home-cooked food, and quiet garden bungalows. The trade-off is a rural setting that needs a car or the farm's shuttle, and meals and activities that you book ahead. Best for a slow, nature-close stay.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arrange the chocolate workshop and order home-cooked meals in advance with the owners — it's a small farm that preps to order. No car? Ask about the shuttle from Bangkok or the airport. Allow ~30–45 min to drive to the Khao Yai waterfalls.
pros: Scores 9.2 · bean-to-bar chocolate workshop with farm-grown cacao
Owners look after guests personally — warm, like a friend's place
Tasty home-cooked food with vegetarian options · quiet garden bungalows
Near the waterfall side of Khao Yai · shuttle from Bangkok/airport
cons: Rural — you need a car or the shuttle; nothing within walking distance
Small property with few reviews · meals and activities need booking ahead

entries.name: Wangtaparb Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Saphan Hin · Na Di · near Kaeng Hin Phoeng
entries.addr: 40 Moo 4, Saphan Hin, Na Di, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Wangtaparb Resort is a riverside resort that doubles as a direct base for Kaeng Hin Phoeng white-water rafting — 9.0 from 40 reviews. It arranges the rafts, kayaks and guide team all in one place, which suits groups of friends and company trips. Rooms are riverside houses with private balconies — you wake up to water and forest — and there's a restaurant and mini-mart on site. The rapids are strongest and most scenic from July to October, so it suits anyone wanting to sleep right by the water in nature on a mid-range budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For rafting, aim for July–October when the water is high, book your room with the activity package early, and ask for a house with the balcony facing the river.
pros: Kaeng Hin Phoeng rafting base — rafts and guide team on site
Riverside houses with balconies for morning river views
Restaurant and mini-mart inside the resort
Quiet, shady and great for a nature stay
cons: Out in Na Di, far from town — you need to self-drive
Nature-focused, with no spa or luxury pool

entries.name: IRabbit Hotel
entries.badge: 🐰 Best in town · walk to the market
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Mueang · town centre · walk to night market
entries.addr: 54 Chaeng Phatthana Rd, Na Mueang, Mueang, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: IRabbit Hotel is the best town hotel in Prachinburi if you want design and cleanliness — 9.1 from 26 reviews. It's a minimal-style 3-star on Chaeng Phatthana Road, within walking distance of the night market (~600 m) and Prajinwanarom public park. The draw is clean, more modern-looking rooms than the older town hotels, free parking and bike rental, and a 15-minute drive to Abhaibhubejhr — ideal for business or for seeing the town without a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a room away from the main road for quiet. There's a ~500 baht deposit at check-in (refunded at check-out) — have it ready.
pros: Central location — walk to the night market and park
Clean, modern minimal-design rooms
Free parking and bike rental to explore town
Near Abhaibhubejhr — a 15-minute drive
cons: Slightly pricier than the province's plainer hotels
A town hotel, so no pool or spa

entries.name: The Resort Kabinburi
entries.badge: 🆕 New build, strong Wi-Fi, mid-route stop
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mueang Kao · Kabin Buri · on Route 304
entries.addr: 678/1 Moo 8, Mueang Kao, Kabin Buri, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: The Resort Kabinburi is a 2023-opened resort that's spot-on for a mid-route overnight on a budget — 8.8 from 30 reviews. It's a 30-room bungalow setup on Highway 304 in Kabin Buri; you turn off the main road and you're at your door. Reviewers consistently mention spacious, clean rooms, parking right at the room, and Wi-Fi strong enough to work or stream — rare at this price point. It suits anyone driving from Bangkok toward Isan or Khao Yai who wants a one-night stop.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a room set back from the road for quiet. There's no breakfast, so plan to eat out or grab something from the on-site mini-mart.
pros: Newly opened resort — spacious, clean rooms
Strong Wi-Fi for working and streaming
Parking right at your door for easy loading
On Route 304, easy to find for a mid-route stop
cons: No breakfast — you'll need to eat out
Built for overnight stops, with no pool or spa

entries.name: Jiphome Prachin Buri
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rop Mueang · town centre · near Abhaibhubejhr
entries.storyHtml: Jiphome is a cafe stay opened in 2025 that feels more like crashing at a friend's place than a hotel. The main rooms are roughly 25 sqm with a king bed and a sofa bed, in Rop Mueang in central Prachinburi. The draw, per real reviews, is rooms that are clean, fresh-smelling and bigger than expected, plus the on-site Jiphome Cafe for good morning coffee and a pet-friendly policy. The catch: it's brand new with few reviews so far, and some rooms have no fridge — worth asking before you book.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Make the most of the on-site cafe for morning coffee. Pets cost about ฿250 — flag it when booking — and check about a fridge if you need to keep things cold.
pros: Clean, fresh-smelling rooms, bigger than expected for the price
On-site Jiphome Cafe to relax over coffee
Warm, homely atmosphere
Pet-friendly with on-site parking
cons: Opened 2025 — few real reviews yet
Some rooms have no fridge, and there's no pool

entries.name: Peamsuk Sweet Prachin Buri
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Mueang · town centre · ~170 m to market
entries.addr: 64/1 Prachin Rd, Na Mueang, Mueang, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Peamsuk Sweet is a budget town hotel that gives you roomy rooms and a great location well above its price — 8.1 from 22 reviews. It's a 2-star on Prachin Road, just ~170 m from the night market. Reviewers consistently note rooms that are bigger than expected, cold AC, and roomy free parking, all from ฿490. It suits in-town errands or a one-night stop — just check the room for cleanliness on arrival, as it's a budget property.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The night market is a 170 m walk for an easy dinner. Ask for an upper floor or a room off the road for quiet, and give the room a quick once-over on arrival.
pros: Central — a ~170 m walk to the night market
Rooms bigger than expected for the price, with cold AC
Roomy free parking, 24-hour reception
Near convenience stores and restaurants on foot
cons: A budget hotel — plain decor for the price
No breakfast, and a few reviews found insects — check the room first

entries.name: Suntisuk Place
entries.revCount: 108 reviews · the most in this guide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Phra · on Highway 33 · route up to Khao Yai
entries.storyHtml: Suntisuk Place is the most-reviewed budget stay in this guide — 108 reviews, scoring 7.8. It's a roadside place on Highway 33 (Suwannason Rd) in the Ban Phra–Noen Hom area. What guests mention most is the main-road location that's easy to pull in and out of, and wide parking right at the room. Rooms are plain but clean enough from ฿600 — handy for self-drivers passing through or stopping over before heading up to Khao Yai on the Prachinburi side.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Reception keeps set hours, not 24h — call ahead to arrange key pickup if you arrive late. Ask for an inner room away from the road for quiet.
pros: Most reviewed stay in this guide — 108 reviews
Free parking right at your door, easy to access
Plain but clean rooms at a budget price
On Highway 33, good for a stop before Khao Yai
cons: Outside town — nothing within walking distance, you need a car
Reception keeps set hours, and some rooms hear road noise

entries.name: Greenfield Residence
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Ngam · Mueang Prachinburi · 5 min to Abhaibhubejhr
entries.storyHtml: Greenfield Residence is a quiet, tucked-away stay that's spot-on for self-drivers visiting a patient or doing errands near Abhaibhubejhr — 7.9 from 12 reviews. It's a 3-star residence in a lane in Tha Ngam, about 200 m off the main road. The draw is the quiet, clean rooms with private garden-view balconies, and a 5-minute drive to Abhaibhubejhr Hospital and Wat Kaeo Phichit, from ฿650. It suits people with a car more than those wanting to walk around town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pin the map before you set off — it's in a lane and tricky to find the first time. Ask for an upper-floor garden-view room for quiet and a better view.
pros: Quiet, tucked in a lane — good for resting or visiting a patient
Clean rooms with no musty smell and private balconies
5 minutes to Abhaibhubejhr and Wat Kaeo Phichit
Free parking and 24-hour reception
cons: In a lane — better suited to people with a car
Parking is limited when busy, and there's no pool

entries.name: Narasiri Service Apartment
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Mueang · town centre · near night market
entries.addr: 171 Prachintakham Rd Soi 6, Na Mueang, Mueang, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Narasiri Service Apartment is the cheapest stay in this guide — from just ฿390, central and near the market — 6.3 from 5 reviews. It's a 2-star service apartment on Prachintakham Soi 6, about 600 m from the town centre. Rooms have AC, a fridge and a TV — the basics, clean enough — with free parking and 24-hour reception. Guests praise the friendly owner and the location near the market, though some note the bed is firm and the fittings are ageing. Best for a single night on a tight budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're worried about a firm bed, ask for a softer room or check on arrival. Call ahead if arriving late so key pickup is smooth.
pros: Cheapest in this guide, from ฿390
Central — near the night market and restaurants
Rooms with AC and a fridge, clean enough
Free parking, 24-hour reception, friendly owner
cons: Scores 6.3 with only 5 reviews — limited feedback
Some reviews note a firm bed and ageing fittings

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate and change with dates and seasons — always check live rates and compare 3 sites before booking. Rooms fill fast on long weekends and holidays, especially the Khao Yai foothill resorts in Noen Hom and small-inventory stays like myrrh. Resort — book 2–4 weeks ahead. Kaeng Hin Phoeng rafting at Na Di is at its strongest and most scenic from July to October. Prachinburi has no metro and its sights are spread out, so having your own car is the most convenient. faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Prachinburi hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Prachinburi?
faq.a: It depends on your plans and whether you have a car. The town centre (Na Mueang–Rop Mueang) lets you walk to the night market and park and sits near Abhaibhubejhr, best without a car (IRabbit, Jiphome, Peamsuk Sweet, Narasiri, Greenfield). Noen Hom is the southern Khao Yai foothills with garden resorts (Siamdasada, myrrh. Resort, Suntisuk). Prachantakham is the waterfall side of Khao Yai with a farm stay (Saengcha Farm). Na Di is the Kaeng Hin Phoeng rafting and riverside side (Wangtaparb). Kabin Buri on Route 304 is a handy mid-route stop (The Resort Kabinburi).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Prachinburi hotels cost?
faq.a: Prachinburi is very affordable: budget town stays start around ฿390–700 (Narasiri, Peamsuk Sweet, Greenfield, IRabbit); foothill and riverside resorts run about ฿1,200–1,900 (Wangtaparb, myrrh., Siamdasada, Tawa Ravadee); and suites or lakeside villas climb to around ฿4,500 (Tawa Ravadee, Siamdasada, myrrh.).

faq.q: ❓ Which Prachinburi hotels have a swimming pool?
faq.a: In this guide, the ones with a pool are Tawa Ravadee Resort (a big pool in a lakeside garden) and Siamdasada Khaoyai (two pools in the Khao Yai foothills). Both are 4-star resorts from ฿1,800–1,900 and sit outside town, so you'll want a car.

faq.q: ❓ I want the Khao Yai feel without going to Pak Chong — where should I stay?
faq.a: Cross over to the Prachinburi side in Noen Hom, the southern Khao Yai foothills that are quieter than Pak Chong. myrrh. Resort ฿1,500 is a private-house stay scoring 9.2 with an on-site cafe and pet-friendly policy; Siamdasada Khaoyai ฿1,800 has wide grounds with a lake, two pools and cycling. Both are about 2 hours from Bangkok — you'll want a car.

faq.q: ❓ I want to go Kaeng Hin Phoeng rafting — where should I stay?
faq.a: If you're set on the rafting, stay on the Na Di side right by the put-in. Wangtaparb Resort ฿1,200 is a riverside resort used as a direct rafting base, arranging rafts, kayaks and a guide team on site. The water is strongest and most scenic from July to October, so book your room with the activity package ahead of time.

faq.q: ❓ Visiting a patient at Abhaibhubejhr Hospital — where should I stay?
faq.a: Pick a stay in town or the Tha Ngam side to save travel time. Greenfield Residence ฿650 is in a quiet lane in Tha Ngam, a 5-minute drive to Abhaibhubejhr; IRabbit Hotel ฿700 in town is a 15-minute drive, design-led and within walking distance of the market. Both have free parking and suit self-drivers.
